note: PAPER ONLY. Published anomalies recording forward from 26 Oct 2026. Nothing here is a buy by itself: a rule needs a TRADABLE SMALL / PROVEN frozen 5-year verdict (data/anomaly-lab.json firstRun) or 30+ resolved paper trades on 10+ days with a positive average after 0.8% cost. Halal = the owner's ZAD mark; "unknown" must be checked before any real buy.

ANOM-TSMOM.name: Time-series momentum on single stocks (own 12-1 return above zero)

ANOM-DAYMOM1.name: Intraday (day) return of the last month, top 10% (coordinator's 1-month version)

ANOM-DAYREV1.name: Intraday short-term reversal (last month's intraday losers)

ANOM-DAYNIGHT.name: Day-night interaction: strong intraday, weak overnight (12-1)

ANOM-TOM.name: Turn of the month (SPY, close of day -2 to close of day +3)

ANOM-EAP.name: Earnings-announcement premium (own the stock into its report)
